Title: Successful registration and login with profile verification
Preconditions: Application is accessible at https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/; user is logged out; email is not already registered
Steps: 1. Open Sign in / Register. 2. Enter valid registration details and submit. 3. Log in with the registered email and password. 4. Open the user profile page. 5. Verify displayed profile details.
TestData: First name: Deepak; Last name: Pant; DOB: valid adult date; Address: 12 Test Street; Postcode: 1234AA; City: Testville; State: Florida; Country: valid selectable country; Phone: valid format; Email: unique_timestamp@example.com; Password: ValidPass@123
ExpectedResult: Registration succeeds; login succeeds with the same credentials; profile shows the registered name email and address details without errors.

Title: Invalid login with incorrect password
Preconditions: Application is accessible; a valid registered account exists; user is logged out
Steps: 1. Open Sign in. 2. Enter a valid registered email. 3. Enter an incorrect password. 4. Submit login. 5. Observe error message and authentication state.
TestData: Email: existing registered email; Password: WrongPass@999
ExpectedResult: Login is rejected; clear invalid credentials message is shown; user remains logged out and cannot access protected profile or checkout pages.

Title: Product search returns matching product details
Preconditions: Application is accessible; catalogue contains at least one searchable in-stock product
Steps: 1. Open the home or products page. 2. Enter a valid product keyword in search. 3. Execute search. 4. Open one matching product from results. 5. Verify product name price and availability.
TestData: Search keyword: known product name or partial name from catalogue
ExpectedResult: Search results list relevant matching products; selected product detail page shows correct name price and available status; no empty-result state for a valid keyword.

Title: Add multiple products to cart and verify cart contents
Preconditions: User can browse products; cart is empty or known baseline; selected products are in stock
Steps: 1. Open product A and add to cart. 2. Return to catalogue and open product B. 3. Add product B to cart. 4. Open the cart. 5. Verify both products quantities and line totals.
TestData: Product A: first available tool/item; Product B: second different available item; Quantity each: 1
ExpectedResult: Cart contains both selected products; quantities are 1 each; line totals and cart total equal the sum of displayed product prices.

Title: Update cart quantity and recalculate totals
Preconditions: At least one product exists in the cart with quantity 1
Steps: 1. Open the cart. 2. Increase quantity of an item to 2. 3. Observe line total and cart total. 4. Decrease quantity back to 1. 5. Verify totals recalculate correctly.
TestData: Initial quantity: 1; Updated quantity: 2 then 1; Product: any in-cart item with known unit price
ExpectedResult: When quantity becomes 2 line total equals 2 x unit price and cart total updates; when quantity returns to 1 totals revert correctly; no negative or stale totals remain.

Title: Complete checkout using Cash on Delivery with double confirm
Preconditions: User is logged in; cart has at least one in-stock product; billing details are available
Steps: 1. Proceed to checkout from cart. 2. Enter or confirm billing and delivery details. 3. Select Cash on Delivery. 4. Press Confirm once and observe state. 5. Press Confirm a second time. 6. Capture success and invoice reference if shown.
TestData: Payment method: cash-on-delivery; Billing street: Zoey Shore; City: Hesselbury; State: Florida; Country: valid country; Postal code: 1234AA
ExpectedResult: After the first confirm the order is not fully finalized; after the second confirm checkout completes successfully and invoice generation is triggered for COD payment.

Title: Verify generated invoice under My Invoices
Preconditions: User completed COD checkout with double confirm; invoice was generated for the current user
Steps: 1. Open My Invoices. 2. Locate the latest invoice for the completed order. 3. Open invoice details. 4. Compare products quantities totals address and payment method with the cart and checkout data.
TestData: Invoice from latest COD order; Expected payment method: Cash on Delivery / cash-on-delivery; Products and totals from prior cart
ExpectedResult: Invoice is listed for the logged-in user; invoice details match ordered products quantities totals billing address and COD payment method.

Title: Checkout blocked when cart is empty
Preconditions: User is logged in; cart contains no products
Steps: 1. Open the cart and confirm it is empty. 2. Attempt to proceed to checkout. 3. If checkout page opens attempt to select COD and confirm. 4. Observe system response.
TestData: Cart: empty; Payment method attempt: cash-on-delivery
ExpectedResult: User cannot complete checkout with an empty cart; clear guidance or disabled checkout is shown; no invoice is generated.
